StorytellerDef.label: Mason and Kaldalis
StorytellerDef.description:
Mason and Kaldalis share one event schedule. Mason favors preparation and opportunities; Kaldalis favors challenges. A challenge pulse spends upcoming event opportunities early, followed by a compensating wait. Major threats always share the same minimum interval.
Facing enemies and caring for people earns honor; treating people as resources loses it. Honor affects humanlike colonists' morale, combat performance and obedience, never incident selection. Ideology may reduce penalties but does not remove them. At exceptional honor, eligible colonists proactively extinguish themselves, and one daily appeal across the colony can end a natural mood-caused mental break. Select a colonist to view the command record.
